entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
🏉📶 The One New Zealand Warriors know a thing or two about gaining metres.
Now Auckland’s mobile and transport network is doing the same.
One New Zealand CEO Jason Paris joined One New Zealand Warriors CEO Cameron George deep inside the City Rail Link tunnels to check out the 4G and 5G coverage now live throughout the underground rail network.
When CRL opens, passengers can keep calling, scrolling and streaming all the way to full-time.
